title: TikTok: Your $1 billion jackpot is not $1 billion

lines.text: You just won the one billion dollar jackpot.
Congrats! But that billion is paid out in thirty yearly payments.
Want it all right now? Then it shrinks to about four hundred sixty million.
Then the IRS shows up and takes up to thirty-seven percent.
Live in New York? State and city take almost fifteen percent more.
Your billion just turned into about two hundred twenty million.
Still not bad, for the moment someone tells you:
